talk.say: No. And let me tell you why so you do not waste a second visit. Last autumn your father Andrea sold me rotten rope for eleven ducats and laughed in my face. Now his daughter comes to the same door with the same eleven ducats and a promise to double it. Eleven is a small number to be a coincidence twice. I put no money in ventures I cannot see, with people I have watched cheat. Nothing from me, not this year, not ever — and I want it noted that no coin passed between us today.

I have seen what I have seen and I wrote down what the physicians said after the last one. I work this season only — nine weeks, to have coin for medicine — and then we are going to Lucia's in Dorsoduro to sleep by the water, and we are staying there. Pack what you love.

So I have to go, and I want you to understand it is not bravery, it is arithmetic: the sickness might take me, the starving certainly will.
